name: Ineptitude + Chemicals = Fun
summary: In the Stonetalon Mountains, Gaxim Rustfizzle seeks a powerful answer to the Venture Company. He asks you to travel across the sea to Ironforge, where Lomac Gearstrip will brew Nitromirglyceronium if you bring the needed alchemical reagents.

sections.title: A Volatile Solution
sections.body: Gaxim Rustfizzle needs powerful explosives for his finest device against the Venture Company. He is stationed high in the craggy passes of the Stonetalon Mountains, far from his former colleague Lomac Gearstrip in Ironforge. Lomac created Nitromirglyceronium, a brew so unstable and destructive that he laughs at the thought of anyone using it, whoever gets blown apart.

sections.title: Potions for Pyrotechnics
sections.body: Lomac wants to see goblin machinery blown to pieces, and perhaps you too. But his Ironforge workshop has run out of Nitromirglyceronium. Before he brews another batch, he asks you for Minor Mana Potions and Elixirs of Minor Fortitude. These draughts provide the raw reagents for his mixture, and gathering them lets Lomac judge whether you have any respect for alchemy.

faq.answer: Lomac Gearstrip is an eccentric gnomish alchemist and tinkerer in Ironforge, the dwarven capital. He once worked with Gaxim Rustfizzle and created the volatile explosive Nitromirglyceronium.

faq.q: Why does Lomac want potions instead of standard engineering parts?
faq.answer: Lomac joins alchemy with his mechanical knowledge to make volatile reactions. Minor Mana Potions provide magical energy, while Elixirs of Minor Fortitude supply stabilizing bodily humors. Both are base reagents for his Nitromirglyceronium mixture.

faq.q: Why send an adventurer all the way to Ironforge for this?
faq.answer: Gaxim Rustfizzle is isolated in the Stonetalon wilds, without heavy industrial or chemical workshops nearby. Lomac Gearstrip in Ironforge is the only associate Gaxim trusts, or fears enough, to supply an explosive potent enough for his finest device.
Nitromirglyceronium is Lomac Gearstrip's explosive chemical brew, known for its volatility. Lomac calls it his greatest creation.

faq.q: Is Lomac worried about the Venture Company or the forest?
faq.answer: Lomac has no concern for the Venture Company or the forest. He laughs at the idea of using explosives to save trees and wants to see either goblins or the courier blasted to pieces.

faq.q: Do you need to be an alchemist to complete this task?
faq.answer: No. Lomac talks of testing your alchemical skill, but he accepts reagents obtained through trade, merchants, or other crafters, as long as you bring the draughts his recipe requires.

angles.text: As a gnome, you see in Lomac the wild edge of gnomish ingenuity. He puts chemical yield and theory ahead of safety or diplomatic caution.
As an Alliance traveler, you know the long journey from Stonetalon to Ironforge strains support for remote outposts scattered across hostile Kalimdor.
As an engineer, you know that when ordinary blasting powder fails against Venture Company steel, alchemy joined with engineering can bring greater destruction.
